new.analysis:
This week builds on the first recovery week, keeping all runs as walk‑run sessions with only 2‑min run and 1‑min walk blocks. The total running time rises from 45 minutes to about 53 minutes, a ~10% increase, and the longest continuous run lengthens from 15 to 18 minutes. The athlete continues three sessions a week, matching the physio‑approved frequency, and rests on the remaining days to allow recovery. No pain was reported last week, so the progression is safe under recovery principles.

The plan keeps every run easy, avoiding hills, strides, or intervals. It respects the rule that a pain‑free week must have zero pain on all runs. Each walk‑run is structured to keep effort low. Rest days are placed after each run to let the left shin heal.

Flags focus on shin pain, run balance, total time, recovery days, and pain escalation. No safety callouts are needed.

There were no questions in the check‑in, so the answers section is empty. Settings proposals are not required.

Headline and flags are concise as required. The plan lines include the date, type, time, structure, and rationale. The formatting matches the specification.
